diagnosis: Transient cart outage. The cart pod cart-78b98c8995-j6z4g was killed and replaced by cart-78b98c8995-x2xgn, created at 20:35:33 and Ready at 20:35:37, just before the alert at 20:35:38. The new pod's wait-for-valkey-cart init container completed, and the cart container runs with 0 restarts. The cart deployment reports available with 1/1 ready replicas and endpoints show 1 ready address. All 20 most recent synthetic journeys succeeded, and the cart logs show normal AddItem/GetCart/EmptyCart traffic. No deploy or config change was recorded in the last 60 minutes. The 3 cart timeouts were likely requests that hit the pod during its replacement. I found no evidence of a persistent fault. The pod kill reason was not visible in events, so it is worth a look if it recurs.
